title: eludite.debug.evaluate input
description: Evaluate a C# expression in the stopped debuggee, in the selected stack frame or a given one, as the Watch window, data tips and the Debug Console do. With `expand`, also list one level of the result's members (fields, properties, elements), which is how the Locals and Watch windows expand a value.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when the solution's policy sets `debug.evaluate` to `prompt`; refused for agents when it sets `debug.evaluate` to `deny`.

session.description: The debugging session to act on (brief 0028): its `id`, from eludite.debug.sessions or `sessions` in eludite.debug.state. Default: the active session, the one the Locals, Watch, Call Stack and Threads windows show and the execution point follows. An unknown or ended id is refused with the ids of the live sessions.

frame.description: Index in the call stack (0 is the top). Default: the selected frame.

expand.description: Also list the result's members (one level, at most 500).

stop.description: The stop the caller saw (`stop` in eludite.debug.state). When given and the debuggee has stopped or resumed since, the command is refused as stale instead of acting on a state the caller did not see (two drivers, PLAN.md 5.5).
